title: EEG Semantic Imagination and Perception Dataset
description: This dataset contains 124-channel EEG recordings from 13 participants who imagined and perceived stimuli from three modalities: visual pictorial, visual orthographic, and auditory. Stimuli came from three semantically dissimilar categories (guitar, flower, penguin). Raw, pre-processed, and epoched versions of the data are provided to support research on semantic decoding from EEG.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a 124-channel ANT-Neuro system. Ten participants completed one session and three completed two sessions. In an imagination and perception task, participants engaged with pictorial, written, or auditory stimuli from three categories: guitar, flower, and penguin.
